concept.title: Cinders over Wyncinder
concept.logline: On ash-choked, epic Wyncinder, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the cooling gems and restore the Caldera Rim.
concept.source_prompt: Ember Caldera. volcano volcanic lava caldera puzzle Locks and keys
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Basalt Refuge and becomes the one who brings the Caldera Rim back to life.

key_locations.name: Basalt Refuge
key_locations.description: The start: a stone shelter cut into cooled lava.

key_locations.name: Pumice Village
key_locations.description: Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Scorched Forge
key_locations.description: Scorched Forge: a ruin on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Ember Shrine
key_locations.description: Ember Shrine: a shrine of Wyncinder, reached by the trail from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Caldera Rim
key_locations.description: Caldera Rim: the far end of the classic hub and trail, where the story ends.

characters.name: Forgemaster Wren
characters.description: Waits in Basalt Refuge and knows why the Caldera Rim fell silent.

characters.name: Nadia the Apprentice
characters.description: Follows you from Basalt Refuge and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Vent Warden
characters.description: A vent warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Lyra the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Wyncinder for anything shiny.

characters.name: Ash Beetle
characters.description: A harmless ash beetle that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Repeat until the way to the finale opens
hazards: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Caldera Rim
Lava vents that scorch anyone who lingers

actions.value: On ash-choked, epic Wyncinder, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the cooling gems and restore the Caldera Rim.
Every site is sealed, and every key lies somewhere else.
The Ember Shrine is sealed by the Caldera Rim Gem.
The Caldera Rim Gem hums. It opens the Ember Shrine.
The seal on the Ember Shrine breaks.
The Pumice Village is sealed by the Ember Shrine Gem.
The Ember Shrine Gem hums. It opens the Pumice Village.
The seal on the Pumice Village breaks.
The Pumice Village Gem hums. It opens the Scorched Forge.
The seal on the Scorched Forge breaks.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: So you've come to Basalt Refuge at last. I am Forgemaster Wren. On ash-choked, epic Wyncinder, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the cooling gems and restore the Caldera Rim.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: Back again. Basalt Refuge is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: Go to Pumice Village, then Scorched Forge. Whatever still remembers Cinders over Wyncinder is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: They say Basalt Refuge was built on what was left of an older place. Ominous, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: Pumice Village: Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Cinders over Wyncinder back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Wren
nodes.text: Scorched Forge: Scorched Forge: a ruin on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Apprentice
nodes.text: Nadia the Apprentice circles your feet, then looks toward Pumice Village as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Apprentice
nodes.text: Nadia the Apprentice hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Apprentice
nodes.text: It turns toward Pumice Village. Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Vent Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Vent Warden, of the watch at Basalt Refuge. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Vent Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Vent Warden
nodes.text: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Caldera Rim. Worst near Pumice Village.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Basalt Refuge. Lyra the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Cinders over Wyncinder that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Pumice Village after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Ash Beetle
nodes.text: The ash beetle freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
